# International Standard Organizations

Standards Organizations are constituted at different levels:

*   **National standards organizations** (e.g. DIN - Deutsches Institut für Normung)
*   **Transnational standards organizations** (e.g. the European Committee for Standardization)
*   **International standards organizations** (e.g. the International Telecommunication Union)

## Some International Standards Organizations:

| Organization | Acronym | Description |
|---|---|---|
| [IEC](http://www.iec.ch/) | IEC | International Electrotechnical Commission |
| [IEEE](http://www.ieee.org/) | IEEE | Institute of Electric and Electronic Engineers |
| [IETF](http://www.ietf.org/) | IETF | Internet Engineering Task Force |
| [ISO](http://www.iso.org/) | ISO | International Organization for Standardization |
| [ITU](http://www.itu.int/) | ITU | The International Telecommunication Union |
| [ITU-R](http://www.itu.int/) | ITU-R | ITU Radiocommunications Sector (CCIR) |
| [ITU-T](http://www.itu.int/) | ITU-T | ITU Telecommunications Sector (CCITT) |
| [IUPAC](http://www.iupac.org/) | IUPAC | International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry |
| [OASIS](http://www.oasis-open.org/) | OASIS | Organization for the Advancement of Structured Information Standards |
| [SI](http://www.bipm.fr/en/si/) | SI | Systéme International d'Unit's (International System of Units) |
| [W3C](http://www.w3.org/) | W3C | World Wide Web Consortium |
| [Accellera](http://www.accellera.org/) | Accellera | Accellera Organization |
